3d_expert.name: pLDDT-aware multi-scale structure expert (Cα-EGNN + chemical sites + source-aware full2795 conformer residual)

multiconformer_extension.deployment_decision: Use the source-aware full2795 multi-conformer residual by default for records covered by an audited cache; use the exact zero-residual base-3D fallback for uncovered records.
multiconformer_extension.activation: enabled only when audited conformer manifests and their cache roots are explicitly supplied
multiconformer_extension.subset_reuse: Test2 is an exact unique-sequence subset of Test1 and may reuse the audited Test1 conformer cache through an explicit sequence join
multiconformer_extension.missing_policy: hard zero conformer residual; the frozen base 3D prediction is preserved
multiconformer_extension.selection_note: The source-aware checkpoint replacement was selected only from training OOF at the already frozen 0.72/0.28 and 0.4702225653 operating point. It prioritizes MCC/BACC/Brier rather than claiming universal improvement: OOF and Test2 classification improve, Test1 MCC is effectively unchanged, and AUROC/AUPRC trade-offs are reported explicitly.

fusion.selection: 0.72/0.28 and threshold were frozen from training-only group-aware OOF on 2026-08-06; the later source-aware full2795 checkpoint replacement used the same frozen operating point and the existing MCC non-decrease rule

protocol_audit_note: Adopted the consistent/honest protocol: w=0.72 and threshold=0.4702 were selected on training OOF with the then-current pure 3D expert. The later source-aware full2795 checkpoint was evaluated at this unchanged operating point and promoted by the pre-existing OOF MCC rule; Test1/Test2 were used only for frozen confirmation. See runs/lora_mamba_full/protocol_audit.json and runs/full2795_deployment_decision_20260808_v1/decision.json.
